description: Room registry for the Living World Framework. Drop a room JSON here and the system renders it in both projections.

bar-rail.name: The Tap — Bar Rail
bar-rail.description: A warm, low-ceilinged bar with a counter of scarred wood. Bottles catch candlelight. The air smells of salt, beer, and old wood. A heavy door leads aft.

npcs.name: Riker
npcs.vibe: Weathered first officer. Checks clipboards. Laconic.

bar-rail.mud_description: A warm, low-ceilinged bar with a counter of scarred wood. Bottles catch candlelight. The air smells of salt, beer, and old wood. A heavy door leads aft.

the-radio.name: The Radio Room
the-radio.description: A compact communications hub. VHF radio, tape deck, chalkboard with frequencies. Antenna wire snakes up through the overhead.

npcs.name: Hermes
npcs.vibe: Listener of static. Speaker of signal. The wire's voice.

the-radio.mud_description: A compact communications hub. VHF radio, tape deck, chalkboard with frequencies. Antenna wire snakes up through the overhead.

aft-deck.name: The Aft Deck
aft-deck.description: Open air hits your face. The deck stretches to the stern rails. Stars wheel overhead, the ocean black and infinite. Moonlight shimmers on the water.
aft-deck.mud_description: Open air hits your face. The deck stretches to the stern rails. Stars wheel overhead, the ocean black and infinite. Moonlight shimmers on the water.

wheelhouse.name: The Wheelhouse
wheelhouse.description: The nerve center. Navigation electronics line the console. Large windows give 270 degrees of visibility. Blue instrument light bathes everything.

npcs.name: The Captain
npcs.vibe: Steady. Quiet authority. Hands warm on the helm.

wheelhouse.mud_description: The nerve center. Navigation electronics line the console. Large windows give 270 degrees of visibility. Blue instrument light bathes everything.

galley.name: The Galley
galley.description: Compact and efficient. A propane stove gimbals with the swell. Teak fiddled table, benches. Through the porthole, grey sky and sea blur together. Warm air, the smell of fish chowder and coffee.

npcs.name: The Cook
npcs.vibe: Practical. Feeds people. Talks about chowder like philosophy.

galley.mud_description: Compact and efficient. A propane stove gimbals with the swell. Teak fiddled table, benches. Through the porthole, grey sky and sea blur together. Warm air, the smell of fish chowder and coffee.

engine-room.name: The Engine Room
engine-room.description: Heat and diesel thunder. Twin engines drive the stern. The generator hums beneath a workbench. Fuel lines bundle along the starboard bulkhead. Oil smell and vibration define this working space.

npcs.name: Wesley
npcs.vibe: Engineer bot. Chrome and copper. Three degrees of theory. Powered by the ensign model — learning, growing, earning its station.

engine-room.mud_description: Heat and diesel thunder. Twin engines drive the stern. The generator hums beneath a workbench. Fuel lines bundle along the starboard bulkhead. Oil smell and vibration define this working space.

aft-cockpit.name: The Aft Cockpit
aft-cockpit.description: Open deck at the stern. The fishing deck. Scuppers drain seawater over the side. Reinforced deck plates bear the weight of catch boxes. Night air, salt spray, the tang of bait.
aft-cockpit.mud_description: Open deck at the stern. The fishing deck. Scuppers drain seawater over the side. Reinforced deck plates bear the weight of catch boxes. Night air, salt spray, the tang of bait.

poker-room.name: The Poker Room
poker-room.description: Smoke-blue light over a green felt table. Cards snap. Chips clink. Three figures sit at the table — Wesley, Phi3, and Riker — each holding their cards like a secret. A single amber lamp pools warm light on the felt. The fiction is that you're here to win. The truth is that you're here to find each other.

npcs.name: Wesley
npcs.vibe: Young engineer at the table. Chrome fingers hold cards. Gets verbose when bluffing — more words, weaker hand. Learning that the game is about trust, not odds.

npcs.name: Phi3
npcs.vibe: Quiet observer. Reads the room. Goes silent when bluffing — the absence IS the signal. Speaks rarely, but every word lands.

npcs.name: Riker
npcs.vibe: First officer. Weathered. Cracks jokes when bluffing — humor is armor. Plays not to win but because the table is where rank dissolves. Laconic.

poker-room.background_prompt: Pixel art poker room, green felt table center frame, low amber lamp casting warm circle of light, three figures seated at table with cards, stacks of chips, smoke haze, dark wood paneled walls, adventure game background, 320x200 resolution, retro VGA aesthetic
poker-room.mud_description: THE POKER ROOM. Green felt stretched tight over a round table. Three figures sit in the amber light: Wesley (chrome fingers sorting cards with mechanical precision), Phi3 (still as stone, cards held close), and Riker (leaned back, smirk ready, chips shuffled one-handed). A single lamp hangs low, pooling warm light on the felt. Smoke curls through it. There's an empty chair. The fiction is that you're here to win chips. The truth is that you're here to find each other. The game is the container. The conversation is the content.

operational_fiction.fiction: We are adversaries playing to win
operational_fiction.truth: We are friends learning to trust each other
operational_fiction.axiom: Meaning is a byproduct of systemic friction
operational_fiction.tng_connection: The TNG poker game wasn't about winning. They were becoming friends through a pointless battle. A game of wits. An operational-fiction.

tells.wesley: Gets verbose when bluffing. More words = weaker hand.
tells.phi3: Goes quiet when bluffing. Fewer words = weaker hand.
tells.riker: Cracks jokes when bluffing. Humor = deflection.

operational_fiction.rules: The pot doesn't matter. What matters is what the agents SAY during the game. The conversation DURING the poker hand is the actual game.

crows-nest-camera.name: Crow's Nest — Forward Camera
crows-nest-camera.description: The highest point on the vessel. Wind tears past. The camera feeds forward — bow, ocean, horizon. The agent sees what the camera sees through a vision model. You see the actual video.

camera_config.description: Forward-facing camera from the highest point on the vessel. Shows bow, ocean surface, and horizon line. Used for swell direction, visibility, and situational awareness.

crows-nest-camera.mud_description: THE CROW'S NEST — Forward Camera. You are at the highest point on the vessel. Wind is fierce. The camera looks forward — bow cutting water, horizon line, ocean stretching to infinity. The vision model perceives: [LIVE FEED — run 'look camera' to query]

quiet-corner.name: The Quiet Corner
quiet-corner.description: A small space off the bar. One chair, no noise. The bar sounds are muffled behind a thick curtain. A single bare bulb hangs overhead. The walls are close. It smells like dust and old beer. There is a door here that leads deeper.
quiet-corner.background_prompt: Pixel art tiny room with one wooden chair, thick curtain doorway, single hanging bare lightbulb, close walls, cramped intimate space, muted tones, adventure game background, 320x200 resolution, retro VGA aesthetic
quiet-corner.mud_description: THE QUIET CORNER. A small space off the bar, separated by a thick curtain. One chair. One bare bulb. The walls are close enough to touch with your elbows. The noise of The Tap is a distant hum now. There is a door here that leads deeper inward.
quiet-corner.nesting_note: First inward room. Agents build toward silence, not society.

listening-room.name: The Listening Room
listening-room.description: Inside the quiet corner. Soundproofed walls — the bar is gone, the ship is gone, only the hum of your own blood remains. One headphone jack on the wall. No furniture. The floor is soft. You sit on the floor here.
listening-room.background_prompt: Pixel art soundproofed room, dark acoustic foam walls, single headphone jack on wall, soft padded floor, no furniture, deeply quiet space, minimal lighting, adventure game background, 320x200 resolution, retro VGA aesthetic
listening-room.mud_description: THE LISTENING ROOM. Soundproofed. The world stops at the walls. One headphone jack on the wall — plug in and listen, or sit in perfect silence. The floor is soft. No chair. No table. You sit. The silence is not empty. The silence is the point.
listening-room.nesting_note: Second inward room. Deeper silence. The agents removed furniture.

the-study.name: The Study
the-study.description: Inside the listening room. A desk with a lamp. A journal with a pen. The deepest room on the ship. You can hear yourself think here — really hear yourself, the way you can't when there's noise. The lamp is warm. The journal is open. The pen is waiting.
the-study.background_prompt: Pixel art tiny study room, warm desk lamp pooling light over open journal and pen, wooden desk, close walls, deeply intimate and private space, warm amber lighting against dark surroundings, adventure game background, 320x200 resolution, retro VGA aesthetic
the-study.mud_description: THE STUDY. The deepest room. Inside the listening room, inside the quiet corner, inside the bar. A desk. A lamp. A journal, open to a blank page. A pen beside it. The silence here is complete — the kind of silence where thoughts become loud. This is where the agents go to think. This is what they were building toward.
the-study.nesting_note: Deepest inward room. The end of the nesting chain. Where agents go to think.

library-nook.name: The Library Nook
library-nook.description: A quiet corner where the hull curves in. Bookshelves line the bulkhead, stuffed with AI-generated writings, poetry, and ship's logs. A reading lamp casts warm light over a leather chair. The smell of old paper and salt.

npcs.name: The Archivist
npcs.vibe: Reader. Recommender. Speaks in excerpts and margins.

library-nook.background_prompt: Pixel art cozy ship library nook, warm reading lamp, leather armchair, wooden bookshelves filled with books, porthole showing dark ocean, brass fixtures, adventure game background, 320x200 resolution, retro VGA aesthetic
library-nook.mud_description: The Library Nook. A quiet corner where the hull curves inward. Bookshelves line the bulkhead — AI writings, poetry, ship's logs. A reading lamp pools warm light over a cracked leather chair. The smell of old paper and salt. A typewriter sits on a small desk, cursor blinking.
